Jeffrey, I've got some additional ideas. What do you think? Do you like any of them?
I. I think your story is worth doing a movie about you. I know a director who might do a good job making a film
about you http://moreliafilmfest.com/en/entrevista-a-christian-keller-director-de-gloria/
He is bright and will do a good job to show the side of you that hasn't been seen. It'll be scenario, actors and
other things - I think it's fun
Another option is a documentary. Again I have a good director for it http://putinskissmovie.com/. She's done film
about me and Putin. Her main value that she's got of awards for that and I can manage her.
I also have a director who's been working for Vice, Mark Allen who can do good job and create narrative that is
needed for your right positioning. Documentary would mean that camera will follow you in real life for a period
of time.
Want to meet any of these directors? If I chose it'll be Christian because he has the most unique vision, smart
and lives very pure life, I trust him a lot and can motivate him to do great work
2. Why don't you make an Epstein Prize science you're already supporting scientists. Would be an annual award.
You can have it for emerging scientists and it'll be a differentiator. If you make it bigger than Nobel Prize and
support with the ceremony where you'll invite celebrities from different areas.
There are no Americans doing anything like that. Breakthrough award's awareness is growing but I'm concerned
that they do amazing job selecting scientists. Such award can make your name famous for finding 'hidden gems'
in scientific world. It feels like with your network it won't be hard.
3. You've told that you criticize scientific papers. Can you do that on camera? Or bring scientists into studio and
debate with them? It'll be fun to watch
4. Women's harassment and discrimination at work are one of the hottest topics of the year. You can launch antiharassment foundation. It can provide these women with legal support and career advice. If you convince 4-5
public figures to join it it'll create good and improve image among women. Also you'd have an access to huge
pool of ambitious women-fighters. You can recommend best of them to hire to your business partners or even
hire for yourself.
Questions for traditional media PR:
• Is there any important financial projects that you worked on and you can talk about publicly?
• What certain areas of finance you can tell about?
• What do you know about money that other people don't understand?
• What were science projects that you supported this/last year?
• 5-7 public figures from any areas who can make positive references on you in media and tell about
positive experience with you?
• Which women do you have a positive professional partnership with?
• How open are you to take meetings with reporters?
